items.text: Surrender your own person to your spouse for the whole span of life.
items.quote: through generous surrender of his own person made to another for the whole span of life

items.text: Have no carnal intercourse outside the marriage bond with another man or woman.
items.quote: By conjugal faith it is provided that there should be no carnal intercourse outside the marriage bond with another man or woman.

items.text: Beget children of love, tenderly care for them, and educate them in a religious atmosphere.
items.quote: children should be begotten of love, tenderly cared for and educated in a religious atmosphere

items.text: Do not break the marriage bond; if separated, do not be joined to another even for the sake of offspring.
items.quote: the marriage bond should not be broken and that a husband or wife, if separated, should not be joined to another even for the sake of offspring
items.conflict: Christ allows divorce and remarriage for marital unfaithfulness (Matthew 19:9); this tradition forbids all remarriage after separation.

items.text: Raise children to become members of the Church of Christ, fellow citizens of the saints, and members of God's household.
items.quote: children who are to become members of the Church of Christ, to raise up fellow-citizens of the Saints, and members of God's household

items.text: Offer your offspring to the Church for baptism, that they may be regenerated and made living members of Christ.
items.quote: it is theirs to offer their offspring to the Church in order that ... they may be regenerated through the laver of Baptism unto supernatural justice
items.conflict: Baptismal regeneration; baptism is a sign and seal, not the cause of regeneration (1 Peter 3:21; Titus 3:5).

items.text: Educate your offspring; do not leave this work unfinished or expose it to certain ruin.
items.quote: this right and duty of educating their offspring belongs in the first place to those who began the work of nature by giving them birth, and they are indeed forbidden to leave unfinished this work

items.text: Since marriage is an indissoluble bond, always give each other care and mutual help.
items.quote: since the parents are bound together by an indissoluble bond, the care and mutual help of each is always at hand

items.text: Shape all your ways of thinking and acting in conformity with the pure law of Christ, so that you and your family may have true peace and happiness.
items.quote: shape all their ways of thinking and of acting in conformity with that pure law of Christ

items.text: Make no pact contrary to the divine laws of marriage: its stability, unity, and firmness.
items.quote: these laws cannot be subject to any human decrees or to any contrary pact even of the spouses themselves

items.text: By free and deliberate consent, hand over and accept the mutual rights proper to marriage.
items.quote: each party hands over and accepts those rights proper to the state of marriage

items.text: Remain joined in the sacred and inviolable bond of marriage, soul knit to soul by a deliberate and firm act of the will.
items.quote: the souls of the contracting parties are joined and knit together ... and from this union of souls by God's decree, a sacred and inviolable bond arises

items.text: Fulfill the high duty entrusted to you for the good of your children.
items.quote: the duty entrusted to parents for the good of their children is of such high dignity and of such great importance

items.text: Keep conjugal faith: fulfill the marriage contract and admit no third party to what belongs to your spouse.
items.quote: mutual fidelity of the spouses in fulfilling the marriage contract

items.text: Keep marriage strictly between one man and one woman, as Christ taught; do not admit polygamy.
items.quote: Christ Our Lord very clearly taught that in this bond two persons only are to be united and joined together

items.text: Do not even look at another with lust, for that is adultery in the heart.
items.quote: whosoever shall look on a woman to lust after her hath already committed adultery with her in his heart.

items.text: In marital intimacy, act with chastity and reverence toward God's work.
items.quote: husband and wife bear themselves in all things with the law of God and of nature

items.text: Love your wife as Christ loved the Church, with a deep attachment of heart expressed in deeds.
items.quote: Husbands, love your wives as Christ also loved the Church

items.text: Help each other day by day to form and perfect your interior life and grow in virtue and love toward God and neighbor.
items.quote: help each other day by day in forming and perfecting themselves in the interior life

items.text: Render the marriage debt to one another as an act of justice and charity.
items.quote: Let the husband render the debt to the wife, and the wife also in like manner to the husband

items.text: Be subject to your husband as to the Lord, with ready subjection and willing obedience.
items.quote: ready subjection of the wife and her willing obedience

items.text: As head, respect your wife's dignity and liberty; do not command what is contrary to right reason or her dignity.
items.quote: it does not bid her obey her husband's every request if not in harmony with right reason or with the dignity due to wife

items.text: Do not use exaggerated liberty that harms the family; as the heart, claim your chief place in love.
items.quote: she may and ought to claim for herself the chief place in love

items.text: Be subject and obedient to him, not as a servant but as a companion, so that nothing be lacking of honor or dignity in your obedience.
items.quote: let her be subject and obedient to the man, not as a servant but as a companion, so that nothing be lacking of honor or of dignity in the obedience which she pays.

items.text: Rule her as head, not as a servant but as a companion, and let divine charity guide you in ruling.
items.quote: The man is the ruler of the family, and the head of the woman; but because she is flesh of his flesh and bone of his bone... Let divine charity be the constant guide of their mutual relations, both in him who rules and in her who obeys.

items.text: If your husband neglects his duty, take his place in directing the family.
items.quote: if the husband neglect his duty, it falls to the wife to take his place in directing the family.

items.text: Let divine charity be the constant guide of your mutual relations.
items.quote: Let divine charity be the constant guide of their mutual relations, both in him who rules and in her who obeys.

items.text: Preserve conjugal faith: unity, chastity, charity, and honorable noble obedience.
items.quote: These, then, are the elements which compose the blessing of conjugal faith: unity, chastity, charity, honorable noble obedience.

items.text: Do not put asunder what God has joined; do not put away your spouse and marry another.
items.quote: What God hath joined together let no man put asunder, and: Everyone that putteth away his wife and marrieth another committeth adultery.

items.text: Do not leave a wife that is sterile in order to take another by whom children may be had; anyone doing this is guilty of adultery.
items.quote: it is wrong to leave a wife that is sterile in order to take another

items.text: Keep the marriage bond unbroken; do not divorce or remarry while your spouse lives.
items.quote: What God hath joined together, let no man put asunder.

items.text: Remain faithful to your spouse, guarding chastity against every incitement to infidelity.
items.quote: a strong bulwark is set up in defense of a loyal chastity against incitements to infidelity, should any be encountered either from within or from without

items.text: Enter marriage not for perishable things or to serve your passions, but to procure for one another a high and lasting good.
items.quote: not for the sake of perishable things nor that they may serve their passions, but that they may procure one for the other high and lasting good

items.text: Give mutual aid and maintain each other's dignity.
items.quote: the dignity of both man and wife is maintained and mutual aid is most satisfactorily assured

items.text: Bear together the burdens of training and educating your children.
items.quote: the grave and long enduring burdens of this office are best borne by the united efforts of the parents

items.text: Fulfill your marital rights and duties faithfully, holily, and perseveringly.
items.quote: they draw supernatural power for the fulfilling of their rights and duties faithfully, holily, perseveringly even unto death

items.text: Strive with all your might that your wedlock remain always the living image of Christ with the Church, a sacred token of perfect love.
items.quote: may be and remain always the living image of that most fruitful union of Christ with the Church, which is to venerated as the sacred token of most perfect love

items.text: Remain bound to your spouse for life; do not divorce or abandon your spouse.
items.quote: various new forms of matrimony they presume to label 'temporary,' 'experimental,' and 'companionate.' These offer all the indulgence of matrimony and its rights without, however, the indissoluble bond

items.text: Keep yourself only for your spouse; flee adultery and all sexual impurity.
items.quote: divorce, adultery, all the basest vices either are extolled or at least are depicted in such colors as to appear to be free of all reproach and infamy

items.text: Do not frustrate the marriage act or deprive it of its procreative meaning.
items.quote: the conjugal act is destined primarily by nature for the begetting of children, those who in exercising it deliberately frustrate its natural power and purpose sin against nature

items.text: Do not deprive your spouse of the marriage debt or undertake continence without your spouse's consent.
items.quote: virtuous continence (which Christian law permits in matrimony when both parties consent)

items.text: Receive the children God gives you and rear them; do not treat them as a disagreeable burden.
items.quote: the natural end of propagating and rearing the offspring would not receive satisfactory provision

items.text: Remain faithful to one another; have no sensual affection or action with any third party.
items.quote: Whosoever shall look on a woman to lust after her hath already committed adultery with her in his heart.

items.text: Give your husband the honorable and trusting obedience you owe him.
items.quote: the honorable and trusting obedience which the woman owes to the man

items.text: Care for your children and do not neglect them for outside business.
items.quote: the wife being freed from the cares of children and family, should, to the neglect of these, be able to follow her own bent

items.text: Honor each other's equal dignity in the rights proper to marriage, and accept the order that the family's good requires.
items.quote: both parties enjoy the same rights and are bound by the same obligations; in other things there must be a certain inequality and due accommodation

items.text: Love one another with true and solid conjugal love, not with a vague compatibility of temperament.
items.quote: on mutual conjugal chastity and strengthened by a deliberate and constant union of spirit

items.text: Never use marriage in a way that deliberately frustrates its natural power to generate life.
items.quote: any use whatsoever of matrimony exercised in such a way that the act is deliberately frustrated in its natural power to generate life

items.text: If your spouse seeks a gravely disordered use of marriage, do not neglect to dissuade and deter him or her from sin.
items.quote: mindful of the law of charity, he or she does not neglect to seek to dissuade and to deter the partner from sin.

items.text: Preserve the life of the child you have conceived, even at risk to your own life.
items.quote: a mother risking her life with heroic fortitude, that she may preserve the life of the offspring which she has conceived

items.text: Do not take the life of your child hidden in the mother's womb, whatever the reason offered.
items.quote: taking the life of the offspring hidden in the mother's womb

items.text: No matter how difficult your circumstances, faithfully fulfill your conjugal duties and preserve conjugal chastity.
items.quote: There is no possible circumstance in which husband and wife cannot, strengthened by the grace of God, fulfill faithfully their duties and preserve in wedlock their chastity unspotted.

items.text: Even in extreme want, rear your children and do not let poverty become an occasion for sin.
items.quote: they should take care lest the calamitous state of their external affairs should be the occasion for a much more calamitous error.

items.text: Stand fast to the commandments of God in all things that matrimony demands.
items.quote: stand fast to the commandments of God in all things that matrimony demands

items.text: Always render to each other the assistance of mutual love.
items.quote: always to render to each other the assistance of mutual love

items.text: Preserve the honor of chastity.
items.quote: to preserve the honor of chastity

items.text: Do not lay profane hands on the stable nature of the bond.
items.quote: not to lay profane hands on the stable nature of the bond

items.text: Use the rights given by marriage in a way always Christian and sacred, especially in the first years of wedlock.
items.quote: use the rights given them by marriage in a way that will be always Christian and sacred, more especially in the first years of wedlock

items.text: Serve the noble purposes of wedlock for the welfare of your children.
items.quote: serve the noble purposes of wedlock for their own welfare and for that of their children

items.text: Let daily good will and cooperation strengthen your marriage.
items.quote: a wonderful strengthening of goodwill and cooperation in the daily life of husband and wife

items.text: Preserve purity and loyalty to one another, and reject any inducement to unfaithfulness.
items.quote: Here we have at a very opportune moment a source of help by which both parties are enabled to preserve their purity and loyalty

items.text: Honor the absolute indissolubility of marriage; do not seek divorce.
items.quote: the absolute indissolubility of wedlock

items.text: Welcome the birth of children and diligently promote their education and upbringing.
items.quote: the birth of children and their tuition and upbringing effectively promoted

items.text: Safeguard your wife's dignity; do not degrade her into an outcast or a slave of lust.
items.quote: the dignity and position of women in civil and domestic society is reinstated by the former; while by the latter it is shamefully lowered

items.text: Love and support one another as bound by God in Christian marriage.
items.quote: binding of man and wife to God through Christian love and mutual support

items.text: Beget and educate children for God as ministers of divine omnipotence.
items.quote: begetting and education of children for God... making the parents the ministers, as it were, of the Divine Omnipotence

items.text: Approach marriage with holy reverence and make it approach the archetype of Christ and the Church.
items.quote: zealously endeavor to make their marriage approach as nearly as possible to the archetype of Christ and the Church

items.text: Do not contract a marriage that would endanger the children's faith and salvation.
items.quote: the danger of the falling away of the Catholic party and the perversion of the children, such a marriage is forbidden also by the divine law

items.text: Maintain close union of mind and heart and do not let conjugal love grow cold.
items.quote: where there exists diversity of mind, truth and feeling, the bond of union of mind and heart is wont to be broken, or at least weakened

items.text: Do not sever the marriage bond by divorce; keep it in the perfection Christ willed.
items.quote: the daily increasing facility of divorce is an obstacle to the restoration of marriage to that state of perfection which the divine Redeemer willed it should possess
items.conflict: Matthew 5:32 and 19:9 permit divorce for sexual immorality

items.text: Do not seek childlessness or kill your offspring; such acts are lustful cruelty.
items.quote: those wicked parents who seek to remain childless, and failing in this, are not ashamed to put their offspring to death.

items.text: Do not be party with your spouse to procuring sterility or killing your offspring; if both do so, you are not true spouses.
items.quote: If both man and woman are party to such practices they are not spouses at all.

items.text: Maintain chaste honor between husband and wife.
items.quote: the chaste honor existing between man and wife

items.text: Render due subjection to your husband.
items.quote: the due subjection of wife to husband

items.text: Bind yourselves to one another with true love.
items.quote: the true love which binds both parties together

items.text: Submit to your husband as lower to higher for the right ordering of the home; acknowledge order and seek peace.
items.quote: the lower be subject to the higher, so that he who would have subject to himself whatever is below him, should himself submit to whatever is above him

items.text: Keep chastity in the nuptial union and curb carnal desires, relying above all on God's grace, not natural means alone.
items.quote: They are mistaken who think that these means are able to establish chastity in the nuptial union, or that they are more effective than supernatural grace.

items.text: Before entering married life, strive together to dispose of or at least lessen the material obstacles in your way.
items.quote: the parties themselves, for a considerable time before entering upon married life, should strive to dispose of, or at least to diminish, the material obstacles in their way.

items.text: Give one another reciprocal conjugal aid.
items.quote: just laws must be made for the protection of chastity, for reciprocal conjugal aid, and for similar purposes

items.text: Cooperate with your spouse and faithfully fulfill the duties of marriage, relying on God's grace.
items.quote: striving to fulfill their duties to the best of their ability and with unwearied effort.

items.text: Help one another endure life's hardships and pursue your eternal salvation, growing into the fullness of Christ.
items.quote: help each other in sustaining the vicissitudes of life, and yet more in attending to their eternal salvation

items.text: Bring up your children as perfect men and perfect Christians, instilling in them a sound understanding of the Catholic Church and love for their fatherland.
items.quote: bring up their children as perfect men and perfect Christians... instill into them a sound understanding of the Catholic Church
items.conflict: Sola Scriptura: teach children the Word of God, not submission to the Roman Catholic Church.

items.text: Repress bad inclinations from childhood, foster good ones, and imbue your children's minds with doctrines that begin with God.
items.quote: The inclinations of the will, if they are bad, must be repressed from childhood, but such as are good must be fostered

items.text: Ask your parents' prudent advice about choosing a spouse and do not treat it lightly.
items.quote: let them not omit to ask the prudent advice of their parents... regard this advice in no light manner
